hypothesis: V26's causal small GRU had the strongest recent action rank correlation but its absolute payoff forecasts were worse than the causal candidate-mean control. Fit a per-fold candidate prior from only matured training labels, train the same GRU on context residuals, and rank prior-plus-residual utility against WAIT. Persist and audit the prior inside each checkpoint. This tests whether residual learning improves candidate ordering without discarding the stable action prior.
selection: Fixed16 epochs, all3 seeds x11 contiguous folds, no winner-seed or fold selection and no threshold/portfolio tuning. Candidate priors use only each fold's 730-day past-only training rows with the fixed8-day label embargo. All dates are opened development, not an independent test.
target: Calendar-geometric net >=5% monthly and global drawdown <=20% after normal fee, fee-stress and execution-stress scenarios; report gross, fees, funding, net, coverage and fills. No live approval.
compute: Private free Kaggle T4x2 only for heavy training; local GTX1650 inference/replay/backtests. Do not mutate v19/v21/v22/v23/v25/v26/v28 exports.
